subject: Data Engineering
title: Materializations in dbt
description: Learn Materializations in dbt in one minute.

hook.text: Should this model be a view or a table? An incremental load or a full rebuild? The choice affects cost and speed.

buildup.text: dbt materializations define how a model is stored: as a view, table, incremental table, or ephemeral CTE.

discovery.text: Views are cheap but slow for heavy queries. Tables are fast but expensive to rebuild. Incremental adds only new rows.

twist.text: Choosing the wrong materialization wastes money or creates stale data. One size does not fit all models.

climax.text: A well-tuned dbt project uses views for light models, tables for heavy ones, and incremental for large datasets.

punchline.text: View, table, or incremental. Choose per model, not globally.

quiz.question: When should you use an incremental materialization in dbt?
options: For large tables where rebuilding from scratch is too expensive
For every model in the project
Only for models with fewer than 100 rows
